description: This file is a shell script for testing the 'git blame' command with various output formats and scenarios. It sets up a git repository, makes commits, and verifies the output of blame commands against expected results.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a description.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares files or output to expected results.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Pauses or waits for a condition, used in test setup.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.
